Methodology paper 'A Rosetta Stone for AI Benchmarks' (arxiv 2512.00193, Anson Ho et al) — IRT-style stitching infers benchmark difficulty statistically from overlapping model results, weights harder benchmarks more, avoids inflation from specialized models. Models with <4 benchmark scores or pre-2023 release excluded due to data sparsity.
